description: Dense utility nodes or large import hubs dilute relevance in large codebases
evidence_for: In large repos (etcd caddy eslint gin)
evidence_against: files defining common types/utilities have in-degree > 50-100. Static PageRank and unnormalized diffusion promote these hubs to ranks 1-5
confidence_level: demoting true gold files in 70 queries (BM25_WIN_CAND_DEMOTED).
next_experiment_needed: In small modular CLI repos (pallets/click, clap-rs/clap), hubs link commands to handlers, increasing MRR (+0.1841 in click, +0.1516 in clap).
column9: Workload-conditional degree normalization (1/sqrt(d)) or hub dampening on in-degree > 20

description: Cross-package edges introduce irrelevant results across uncoupled modules
evidence_for: Regex symbol resolution (imp in self.symbol_to_paths) links files across package boundaries without checking visibility. In caddy and etcd
evidence_against: common symbol names (Parse New Init) link unrelated plugins.
next_experiment_needed: symbol-to-path resolution correctly links helper functions.
column9: Enforce package/directory boundary fencing on symbol resolution; reject edges between unlinked workspace packages

description: Static graph score scale overwhelms lexical relevance at early ranks
evidence_for: Candidate C adds static query-independent pagerank_scores with equal 1/3 weight. Files with zero query terms receive up to +0.33 score solely from graph centrality
evidence_against: displacing exact lexical matches with 0.30 score.
confidence_level: For vague or short queries lacking distinctive identifiers
next_experiment_needed: static graph centrality surfaces main entry points.
column9: Replace static PageRank with query-seeded Personalized PageRank (PPR) or reduce static graph weight from 0.33 to <= 0.05

description: Bidirectional diffusion propagates relevance energy too far across call graph
evidence_for: Candidate F diffuses score to both successors (0.25) and predecessors (0.20) with no degree normalization. When a seed imports common libraries
evidence_against: energy reflects back to all callers across unrelated subsystems.
next_experiment_needed: backward caller diffusion occasionally surfaces affected blast-radius call sites.
column9: Asymmetric directed-only diffusion; restrict predecessor diffusion to direct call graph edges with strict attenuation (0.05)

description: Graph edges are missing for relevant test and reflection-loaded files
evidence_against: test files rarely import implementation files directly in Go/Rust conventions
confidence_level: leaving test files disconnected. Candidate F achieves only 0.0601 MRR on code2test vs RepoMap 0.2284.
column8: test_*.py) partially associate tests with source files.
column10: Add explicit lexical-path bipartite heuristic edges between implementation and test directories

description: Manifest and symbol parsing create incorrect edges via short-name collisions
evidence_for: In graph.py:346-349, self.module_to_path[short_name] binds single-word file basenames, causing collisions where any file ending in util.py or types.go overwrites lookup.
evidence_against: Exact module paths (flask.app) resolve reliably without collision.
next_experiment_needed: Disallow ambiguous short-name aliasing in module_to_path and enforce fully qualified module keys

description: Graph ranking adds relevant files late (ranks 11-20) but demotes strong lexical matches (ranks 1-2)
evidence_for: BM25 achieved 21 Rank-1 hits and 34 Rank-2 hits (38.0 RR points). Candidate F dropped to 7 Rank-1 hits and 20 Rank-2 hits (17.0 RR points). The loss of 21.0 RR points at the top overwhelmed the 25 additional hits at ranks 11-20 (which added only ~1.8 RR points).
evidence_against: None. This mathematical tradeoff holds across all 345 positive queries.
next_experiment_needed: Cascaded two-stage retrieval: freeze top-3 lexical candidates and restrict graph reranking to ranks >= 4
